text: Good morning, Lena. It is me. I am sitting in the kitchen with your coffee cup, the blue one. I use it now, I hope that is all right.
say: Good morning, Lena. It is me. I am sitting in the kitchen with your coffee cup, the blue one. I use it now, I hope that is all right.

text: Yesterday I picked the last apples from the tree behind the house. Your father says there are too many, and then he eats four.

text: Do you remember the night we slept in the garden to count shooting stars? You counted eleven. I think about that when I look up now.

text: Look after yourself up there. Do the small things, even the boring ones. I want you back just as you left.

text: I will record again tomorrow morning. I love you. Goodbye for now.

text: Hey Lena, Jonas here. The kids drew your ship again. This time it has six windows and a dog.

text: I finally fixed your old bike. It is waiting in the garage for when you are back.

text: Talk tomorrow. Well, you know what I mean. Bye.

text: Lena, it is Priya. The whole simulator team watched your docking replay at lunch. Nobody touched their food.

text: Your desk plant is alive. I am as surprised as you are.

text: More tomorrow. Fly safe.

text: One thing before the next message. ORBIT asked to say this to you in its own words.

text: When you have taken it, tell me the numbers. Then we go on.

text: Good to hear. ORBIT goes by the reading, not by how you feel, so it asks again.

text: That is all Marta recorded today. What you just said is saved as your reply and reaches Earth in about 5 min.

text: Blood pressure has been well below your normal in this phase (Outbound to Mars: about 112/67) on two readings in a row.

text: Sit or lie down, drink water, and repeat the reading after 5 minutes. Tell the medical lead today.
